_comment: Magic Find quality-scoring weights + deep-scan pool size. Loaded by scripts/magic.py (load_weights): any subset overrides the code defaults, unknown keys (like this one) are ignored, a missing key keeps its default. Each dimension score is normalized to [0,1] before weighting; the defaults sum to 1.0 so the total is a clean quality fraction. Price/beitrag is NEVER part of the score (display + final tiebreak only). Tracked, no PII.
